chain.note: The two trees are identical: both run S5.1-S5.6 (bank exchange, frames, labels, s_b and s_c below Wm, tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}) into S5.8-S5.11 (shear, interchange and layer recurrences with factor s/W<m^tau) and on through S6-S8 to the time bound O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}), so neither chain thins out where the other does not.
